activities.activity: Review Ultra-Light Wing Structure architecture allocation
activities.rationale: Confirm the module has a coherent purpose, submodule breakdown, interfaces and component allocation before any procurement work.
acceptanceCriteria: Every submodule has a stated purpose and at least one component candidate.
Interfaces named on the module are carried by the responsible submodule where the design depends on that interface.
No blocker or major architecture issue is attached to the module.

activities.activity: Verify Ultra-Light Wing Structure requirement calculations
activities.rationale: Tie parsed brief requirements to explicit engineering calculations or sanity checks before accepting the design envelope.
acceptanceCriteria: Each linked requirement has a calculation, sanity check or clearly stated deferred validation path.
No linked sanity check is failing.
Warnings have named follow-up calculations or test evidence.

activities.activity: Collect source-backed evidence for Ultra-Light Wing Structure critical components
activities.rationale: Critical component candidates may support architecture review, but BoM cost/manufacturer/MPN claims are blocked until source-backed evidence is admitted.
acceptanceCriteria: Supplier name, manufacturer or equivalent, MPN where applicable, unit cost and source URL/reference are present.
Evidence is explicitly retrieved and admissible under the sourcing admission protocol.
Claimed quantity and component identity match the architecture candidate line.

activities.rationale: Solar array output must feed power management over a declared DC bus.

Electrical, thermal, fluid, mechanical or data capacity is validated by the next detailed design pass.

activities.activity: Plan evidence for CAA-UAS-OPS
activities.rationale: High-altitude unmanned aircraft operational safety case
acceptanceCriteria: Airspace concept of operations, detect-and-avoid assumptions, command link and recovery evidence.
blockers: Compliance evidence not yet collected in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Plan evidence for DO-160-ENV
activities.rationale: Airborne equipment environmental conditions
acceptanceCriteria: Temperature, vibration, electrical power and EMC environmental evidence tailored to stratospheric operation.
blockers: Compliance evidence not yet collected in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Plan evidence for SOLAR-ENERGY-BALANCE-REVIEW
activities.rationale: Solar day/night energy balance review
acceptanceCriteria: Solar collection, battery night-cycle, propulsion load and station-keeping wind model evidence.
blockers: Compliance evidence not yet collected in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Review risk control for Energy-negative overnight operation
activities.rationale: Provisional RPN 200; mitigation: Solar/battery energy balance, night-cycle reserve and wind-aware station-keeping plan.
acceptanceCriteria: Severity, occurrence and detection ratings have been reviewed by a domain owner.
Mitigation is accepted, corrected or converted into a design action.
Any residual high-risk item has an owner before publication.
blockers: Risk evidence not yet reviewed in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Review risk control for Wing structural failure in gust or launch handling
activities.rationale: Provisional RPN 135; mitigation: Aeroelastic analysis, ground load test and launch/recovery handling limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Severity, occurrence and detection ratings have been reviewed by a domain owner.
Mitigation is accepted, corrected or converted into a design action.
Any residual high-risk item has an owner before publication.
blockers: Risk evidence not yet reviewed in scratch prototype.

activities.activity: Review risk control for Lost command link or uncontrolled descent
activities.rationale: Provisional RPN 120; mitigation: Redundant telemetry, autonomous return/loiter logic, geofence and recovery parachute.
acceptanceCriteria: Severity, occurrence and detection ratings have been reviewed by a domain owner.

Any residual high-risk item has an owner before publication.
